description.value:
You learn to unleash and control more of the beast within. You can use your Hybrid Transformation feature twice, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Short or Long Rest. Your hybrid form also gains the following benefit.

Lycan Regeneration. At the start of each of your turns when you have at least 1 Hit Point but fewer than half your Hit Points remaining, you regain Hit Points equal to 1 plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 Hit Point). While in hybrid form, you regain these Hit Points before you make the saving throw for your Bloodlust.
